sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Open MPI 環狀歸約：啟動延遲與頻寬成本
related.titleEn: Open MPI ring reduction: startup latency and bandwidth costs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：結果正確性與速度改善分開通過；未知進度不標示成功。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Correctness and speed improvement pass separately; unknown progress is not labeled successful.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Open MPI 環狀歸約：啟動延遲與頻寬成本」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付逐輪資料流、延遲分解、與樹狀假設不同之處。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Open MPI ring reduction: startup latency and bandwidth costs with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver round-level dataflow, latency decomposition and differences from tree assumptions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 畫 12 ms 計算與 8 ms 通訊同時啟動的區段，再加 2 ms 序列成本。
將 80000 bytes 分成八塊，計算每輪 1 μs 傳輸加 2 μs 啟動。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Draw concurrent 12 ms compute and 8 ms communication, then add 2 ms serial overhead.
Split 80000 bytes into eight blocks; each round has 1 μs transfer and 2 μs startup.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Lustre PFL：成長檔案的元件與目標扇出
related.titleEn: Lustre PFL: components and target fan-out for growing files
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：結果正確性與速度改善分開通過；未知進度不標示成功。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Correctness and speed improvement pass separately; unknown progress is not labeled successful.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Lustre PFL：成長檔案的元件與目標扇出」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付兩組尺寸直方圖、元件邊界與物件需求估計。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Lustre PFL: components and target fan-out for growing files with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver two size histograms, component boundaries and object-demand estimates.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 畫 12 ms 計算與 8 ms 通訊同時啟動的區段，再加 2 ms 序列成本。
將 900 張小檔卡與 100 張成長檔卡換算物件需求。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Draw concurrent 12 ms compute and 8 ms communication, then add 2 ms serial overhead.
Convert 900 small-file cards and 100 grown-file cards into object demand.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
